phase3_findings.description: Nothing in the types prevents ResultMaskingRunner from being composed beneath RlsGuardRunner; _relation_check_executor only unwraps RlsGuardRunner/ReadOnlyGuardRunner/RowCapRunner and ResultMaskingRunner.run_sql declares require_base_tables, so a mis-ordered stack would silently skip the relation check. Only the factory comment and test_masking_guard_is_outermost enforce the order; today's composition is correct.
